title: 🤖 Filter stage-specific shader inputs from group menus
body:
> [!INFO] *AI disclosure*: This contribution was authored by on an autonomous AI agent, on behalf of a user to fix invalid input presets in visual shader groups.

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

The Create Shader Node menu offers stage-specific inputs inside groups, although the Input dropdown excludes them. Filter named presets through the existing group input list. Keep global inputs such as TIME and the generic Input node available.

- Closes #124755.

## Additional information

Validation: formatting, include validation, diff checks, and MSVC compilation of the changed translation unit passed. Compilation used `debug_symbols=no` after the local PDB manager failed with C1902. Full editor menu verification remains pending.

This draft needs menu checks in standalone and nested groups, including search, connection suggestions, and favorites. Source review and the patch were produced with AI assistance.
